field_records.note: getter loads the member object from [outer + 0x788] before calling the stub
stub loads the distinct-sum head object from [member + 0x28] before tail-jumping to the distinct sum
distinct sum reads the next cycle node from [node + 0x1028]; the walk stops when the node equals the head object
distinct sum reads the signed 32-bit group count from [node + 0x50]; count <= 0 skips that node
distinct sum reads the group array base from [node + 0xad8]; groups are 24-byte entries, each with a begin pointer at +0 and an end pointer at +8
for every pointer in a group's [begin, end) range the distinct sum reads the element pointer, then the key at [element + 0x08] for the membership test
only on a first occurrence does the distinct sum add the qword at [element + 0x10] to the running total

non_claims: Object contents beyond outer + 0x788, member + 0x28, cycle node + 0x50/+ 0xad8/+ 0x1028, and group-element + 0x08/+ 0x10 are not modelled
The third qword of each 24-byte group entry is never read and is not modelled
The head object's own groups are never summed; only the cycle nodes after it are visited
The insert callee 0x5f90bb0 was not read; the set-node layout and the insert's bucket mechanics are by contract, and only the observable membership contract is pinned
The landing pad at 0x5f91247 jumps to 0x5f90fe2 outside this window; that code was not read and is not modelled
The getter has no callers file-wide, so no external caller argument setup is claimed
Neighbouring getter 0x5eeb6a0 and its target 0x5f6cb70 are not covered; they need their own scope check

semantics.distinct_sum: node = [head + 0x1028]; if node == head return 0; total = 0; seen = {}; while node != head: count = signed32([node + 0x50]); if count > 0: for each of the first count 24-byte groups at [node + 0xad8]: for each pointer p in [group.begin, group.end): element = *p; key = [element + 0x08]; if key not in seen: insert(set, element + 0x08) by contract, seen.add(key), total += [element + 0x10] (64-bit wrapping); node = [node + 0x1028]; destroy the local set, check the stack canary, return total
semantics.forwarding_stub: tail-jump to 0x5f91010 with rdi = [member + 0x28]; no ret of its own
semantics.getter: *out = distinct_sum([[outer + 0x788] + 0x28]); return 1 unconditionally; no null check
